texts.name: Niusha
texts.biography: Niusha’s childhood was marked by the chains of slavery until the hand of King Shayan granted her freedom. Since then, she has served as a loyal and formidable warrior of Refuge, her loyalty matched only by her prowess in battle. With her past fueling her determination, she stands as a beacon of resilience and strength, a testament to the indomitable spirit of the freed.

specialty.name: Offense
specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill.
